headline.purpose: Object page title (an investigation); 17px and 3-line clamp at 820px and below.

body.purpose: Default UI text; tabular numerals on.

label.purpose: Section labels over lists, the properties heading, panel section headings; pencil grey, sentence case. Source writes 550; Geist as loaded renders 600. Table headers use 500, captions and legends 400, same size.

data.purpose: Run ids, hashes, file paths, times, JSON.

components.name: Route Stops
components.description: Signature: the agent's route as a vertical timeline; node shape and fill show the state.
components.css: .ds-stops { display: grid; padding: 0 6px 8px; } .ds-stop { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0 8px; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 4px 8px 4px 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: 400 12.5px var(--font-ui); color: var(--ink); } .ds-stop::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 9px; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 1.5px; background: var(--rule-2); } .ds-stop:first-child::before { top: 50%; } .ds-stop:last-child::before { bottom: 50%; } .ds-stop:hover { background: var(--hover); } .ds-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--flame); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-node { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-left: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sheet); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink-3); } .ds-ok { border-color: var(--ok); background: var(--ok); } .ds-warn { border-color: var(--ink); border-style: dashed; } .ds-run { border-color: var(--flame); } .ds-ans { border-radius: 2px; border-color: var(--ink); background: var(--ink); } .ds-when { color: var(--ink-3); font: 400 11px var(--font-data); }

narrative.overview:
IGNIS is a research harness, not a dashboard. The page is a white sheet with black type, one grey family and one biro-blue ink. In dark mode the same system becomes "Night and Sky Blue": a blue-black ground with a sky-blue accent. The agent does the work and the researcher reads, checks and decides, so the chrome stays quiet and the evidence gets the colour.

The density is compact. Body text is 13px, controls are 28px high, and hairlines (1px) divide the surfaces. The layout follows the Linear, Harvey, Legora and Hebbia mould: a left rail, a centre object with tabs, a properties column and a right side panel with a back trail. The system refuses tile dashboards, decorative colour and pages that the researcher must drive step by step.

Colour has a meaning or it does not appear. Blue is model output, the current data selection and a running state, orange is revealed data, red is a refusal or a failure, and green is a complete or qualified status. Shape carries the evidence class, so colour is never the only signal.
keyCharacteristics: White sheet, black ink, one grey family, one blue accent (light); blue-black night and sky blue (dark).
One sans family (Geist) for all text; Geist Mono only for ids, hashes, paths, times and code.
Compact: 13px body, 28px controls, 1px hairlines, 8px surface radius.
Flat at rest; shadow only on layers that float above the content.
Evidence classes drawn as CSS shapes: disc, square, diamond, dashed band, hollow ring, dashed ring.
Synthetic origin is one neutral outlined pill, never a coloured banner.

rules.name: The Colour Is Data Rule
rules.body: The chrome is ink and grey. Blue, orange, red and green appear only when they mean model output, selection, a running state, a cited region or the target atmosphere; revealed data; refusal, failure or a wait on the researcher; and complete or qualified status.

rules.name: The No Yellow Rule
rules.body: Caution has no hue. A caution note carries an ink dot, a warn route stop is a dashed ink ring, and a "not qualified" tag stays neutral grey.

rules.name: The Ink Navigation Rule
rules.body: Navigation state is ink, not blue. The current nav item is a wash fill, the active tab is a 2px ink underline, and the primary button is solid ink.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist sets all text. Geist Mono sets only ids, hashes, paths, times and code, never a heading or a label for effect.

rules.name: The 20px Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Inside the workspace no heading is above 20px. The Home question (26px) is the only exception.

rules.name: The Flat At Rest Rule
rules.body: A card, table, sheet or note has no shadow. Use the float shadow only for a layer that sits above the content.

rules.name: The Shape Carries Evidence Rule
rules.body: Each evidence class has a CSS shape that reads without colour: observed is a filled disc, source is a filled square, computed is a diamond, predicted is a dashed blue band, revealed is a hollow orange ring, interpretation is a dashed grey ring, and the cutoff is a 2px ink bar.

dos: Do use biro blue (#1a4be0; dark #5ab9fc) only for model output, the current data selection, a running state, a cited region, the target atmosphere region, focus and inline links.
Do keep every surface flat at rest with a 1px hairline (#ededed), and keep the float shadow for layers above the content.
Do mark every evidence class with its CSS shape (disc, square, diamond, dashed band, hollow ring, dashed ring), so the class reads without colour.
Do show synthetic origin as one outlined pill with a dashed ring in the topbar, and as the inline synthetic tag on fixture values.
Do show a refusal as a red-headed note on refusal wash, with the typed code and the next action; show a gap as an outlined neutral note.
Do set controls at 28px (24px small) with a 6px radius, and surfaces at an 8px radius.
Do set ids, hashes, paths and times in Geist Mono 12px, and everything else in Geist.
Do keep reading text at 66 to 72ch, and keep tabular numerals on.
Do theme the browser surfaces: selection at 22% blue, a 2px blue focus outline at 1px offset, thin scrollbars in the control hairline tone.
Do draw icons from the authored set: 16px grid, 1.5px stroke, round joins.
donts: Don't use yellow or amber for caution or warnings; caution is ink.
Don't use blue for navigation state; the current nav item is a wash fill and the active tab is an ink underline.
Don't use orange for anything except revealed data.
Don't show synthetic origin as a coloured banner.
Don't put a label, tag or pill above a heading as an eyebrow.
Don't build a view from same-size stat tiles or a hero metric; the system is a harness, not a tile dashboard.
Don't add a shadow to a card, table, sheet or note at rest.
Don't use Unicode characters or emoji as icons or as evidence marks.
Don't use a coloured left or right border on notes or cards; notes use a fill.
